rulesTestNames: lets signed-in people get an event chat signal and nothing else
read: any signed-in, non-deleted person gets one event's document; it holds only revision counters, no text, names or membership; nobody lists the collection
write: server only; sendEventChatMessage, setEventChatReaction and actOnEventChatMessage (removal) move messageRevision and setEventChatTyping moves typingRevision in their own transactions; triggers on eventChatRooms (revision changes) and eventChatMemberships move accessRevision
migrationNotes: Replaces the event chat's 3-second listEventChatMessages poll and the participant roster's 15-second poll (#1337). Messages stay behind the callables.
